//: Capability manifest for modal/1 — keen-pure-admin. Maps each NEUTRAL modal feature to this wrapper's assign/kind. `static` maps to is_static: keen DOES emit pa-modal--static (a behavioural JS-hook class with no CSS rule), unlike svelte — so the fixture declares the feature but never exercises it in a golden (see fixture `static` note). `show` is intentionally NOT mapped: keen adds pa-modal--show via phx-mounted at runtime, never in SSR, so it stays out of every golden. See card.map.json for the model.
